purpose: Preserve what a learner actually demonstrated, award bounded partial credit, and propagate acknowledgment without converting assistance or derived credit into mastery.

engineStages.purpose: Separate learner-produced behavior from source/agent material before scoring.
Convert observed construct/apply/debug/explain/discover quality into bounded direct credit.
Cap event-level credit and mastery signal by recorded assistance provenance.
Propagate bounded recognition to explicitly related concepts without creating mastery.
Turn observed credit into plain-language evidence acknowledgment without inflation.
Emit only a single-rep signal; require aggregate direct evidence for mastery.
Identify the weakest facet for the next direct practice event.

principles: Incorrect or incomplete final answers may still contain creditable construction, application, debugging, explanation, or discovery evidence.
Assistance is provenance, not shame; it limits the strongest claim that may be made from the event.
AI output is source or scaffold evidence unless the learner independently reconstructs and transfers the idea.
Cascade credit is acknowledgment-only and never counts as direct mastery evidence.

facets.label: Construct
facets.description: Reconstruct the idea, representation, algorithm, query, or procedure from memory.

facets.label: Apply
facets.description: Use the idea correctly on a concrete task, case, or input.

facets.label: Debug
facets.description: Localize, explain, or repair a failure using evidence.

facets.label: Explain
facets.description: Explain why the approach works, its constraints, or its tradeoffs.

facets.label: Discover
facets.description: Generate a useful question, connection, experiment, or novel inference.

cascade.meaning: Recognition that work on one concept exercised an explicitly declared prerequisite or adjacent concept.

acknowledgementBands.message: A real attempt exists; preserve the evidence and identify the next smallest rep.
You demonstrated part of the process. Keep the earned facets and target the weakest missing facet next.
This rep contains substantial demonstrated understanding, even if the final answer is incomplete.
This is a strong direct rep. Mastery still requires repeated direct evidence and transfer.
